title: Commercial records bother Sam; Cannonball's intelligence
summary: Sam says the hit records troubled him given how intelligent and versatile Cannonball was.

story.theme_name: Playing with and around Miles Davis
story.community_name: Cannonball Adderley: the sound, the man, the band

blocks.x: And they start making money, and they start making money, but they kept on making those records man,
And this is supposed to be a jazz band, you know.

And that part bothered me, uh, very much cause I thought that Cannonball was a, was uhm, too versatile a musician than classical, and the was a very intelligent man, man, uh, very intelligent, there wasn't nothing you could talk about that he couldn't talk back to you about it. He read a lot, he was intelligent, and uh, that bothered me you know, because uh, how can a man with his intelligence, man, uhm get caught up in this kind of stuff. But I found out he was influenced by his brother which wasn't as intelligent as he was.
